## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用户感觉不到。只改了一个测试文件,CI 不再因为它偶发失败。
- 为什么做:卡 #36500(席位的例外卡,你批过)。主从表单的一个测试在明细网格还没就绪时就去读它,#36437、#36438 等不相关的 PR 因此在 Test UI 上被误判失败。
- 出错会怎样:不影响产品行为。可以整体撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。
- 席位意见:ACCEPT。

## 席位核对

- **卡片关系**:首行 `Fixes #36500`。卡上三条完成标准都做到了:
  1. 第 1 个用例对 `gridOf('Lines')` 和 `gridOf('Line Items')` 的读取都放进了同一个 `waitFor`;
  2. 正文写了循环跑的次数:修改前在 main `9abc7321` 上 10 次失败 6 次,失败都在第 1 个用例的 `gridOf('Lines').field`;修改后在本 head 上连续 20 次全绿,每次 9 条通过;
  3. 同目录的其余 7 个 `*Members-8071` 文件:我在本 head 上 `git grep` 过 `gridOf|gridProps`,只有本文件用到,正文的说法属实。
- **代码(只改测试)**:
  - 根因判断我认:页面先画出分区标题,列加载完才挂网格。旧的 `gridOf` 用 `gridProps.slice(-sections)[index]` 按位置取,网格还没挂上时取到 `undefined`;如果某一轮只重画了部分网格,还可能取到别的分区的 props。
  - 新的 mock 给每个挂上的网格一个 `useId`,把它最新的 props 存进 `latestGridProps`,并在旁边画一个带这个 id 的隐藏 span。`gridOf` 先按标题找到分区,再读分区里唯一的那个 span:没有、或不止一个,都会抛出带名字的错误,让外层的 `waitFor` 重试。这样不会再错位,也不会静默返回 `undefined`。
  - 没有断言被删掉或放宽。第 2c、3、6 个用例原来紧跟在等待后面的直接读取,也一并改成了等网格就绪,和同文件里第 2、2b、4、5 个用例的写法一致。`beforeEach` 同时清空了新加的 map。第 7 个用例断言 `gridProps` 为空,所以那个扁平列表还保留着。
  - 隐藏 span 只在测试的 mock 里,没有 role 或 label,文件里没有哪个查询会数分区的子节点,不影响其他用例。
- **不阻塞**:第 2c、3 个用例的 `waitFor(() => gridOf(X))` 拿到的是网格第一次被捕获时的 props。这几个分区的列都是作者写好的,断言的是从配置推出的值(`displayMode`、`onRowExpand`、`sortField`),所以第一次捕获就已经是最终值,不会再次出现时序问题。以后如果有分区改成等列推导,照第 2、5 个用例的写法加 `columns?.length` 守卫即可。
- **声明与 changeset**:`Clause-②: no`、`Metadata-protocol: none` 都对。`@object-ui/plugin-form` 的 `files` 只发 `dist`、README、CHANGELOG 和 LICENSE,测试文件不发运,所以 `skip-changeset` 成立。
- **门禁**:推导出的 27 个族全部在本地跑过,每个都 exit 0,`--ran` 对得上(27 个推导、27 个跑过、0 个没测到)。`check:vi-mock-specifiers` 和 `check:vi-mock-inherit` 都通过。plugin-form 整套 244 个文件全部通过,type-check 包含测试工程,exit 0。
- **CI @ `28dd844a`**:40 success、18 skipped、0 failed,Test UI 各片都是 success;mergeable clean。
- **落地**:非受管。等席位的短 L2 通过后由席位落地;落地后 #36437、#36438、#36461 合入 main 再重跑。

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `28dd844ac5b04149ea6636ee586fcedb198afa6e`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #36500 (body and its three comments: the scope note 7081127197, the claim 7081224132 and the triage note), the PR #36514 body and its one comment (the seat's L1 note, read as input only), the one-file net diff against `main` (merge base `9abc732132a`), and the 58 check-runs on the head. Code outside the diff was read with `git show 28dd844a:PATH` and not reviewed.

### ① Derived judgments

The diff changes one file, `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/masterDetailDetailsMembers-8071.test.tsx`. It changes no accept-set and no public surface. No product code, schema, governed path or published file moves.

The race cause is real. In `MasterDetailForm.tsx` at the head, each section draws its `h3` heading (line 1171) before it mounts `LineItemsField`. While `!d.columns?.length || !gridBodyReady` holds (line 1243), the section shows "Loading columns..." and no grid. Case 1 waited only for the headings. The old `gridOf` then returned `gridProps.slice(-sections)[index]`, which is `undefined` until every section's grid has been captured, so the next `.field` read threw. That matches the failure on the card and the PR's count of 6 failures in 10 runs on main. The slice also assumed whole render passes, so a pass that re-rendered only some grids could hand back another section's props.

The new lookup removes the cause instead of hiding it. The mock gives each mounted grid a `useId` id, keeps that grid's latest props in `latestGridProps` under the id, and draws a hidden span carrying the id next to the real grid. `gridOf(heading)` finds the section by its heading and requires exactly one sentinel inside it. With no sentinel (the grid is not mounted yet) or more than one, or with no props under the id, it throws a named error. So it can no longer return `undefined` or another section's props. The sentinel is in the DOM only while the grid is mounted, so the lookup never reads a stale entry from an unmounted grid. `beforeEach` clears the map. `useId` is valid here because the product renders `LineItemsField` as a JSX component (line 1246), not as a plain function call. The span is a new direct child of `section`, but `headings()` selects `section > h3` and no query in the file counts section children, so the other cases see the same DOM as before.

No assertion was removed or weakened. Every `expect` and every message is kept. The only change is that some reads now happen inside, or after, a `waitFor` on the grid capture. Each wrapped read still runs at the same point in the case as before. A wrong value still fails, because the retry ends with the assertion's own error once `waitFor` times out. The flat `gridProps` list is kept, because case 7 asserts that it is empty.

Every bare read after a heading wait now waits for the grid capture. Case 1 puts both column-order reads in one `waitFor`. Case 2c waits for `Steps, configured`. Case 3 waits for `Wider form` and `Cells only`, the same way it already did for `As a list`. Case 6 puts the `Notes` value in a `waitFor`, the same way it already did for `Lines`. The one bare `gridOf` read left is in case 2 (line 328, `gridOf('Lines').displayMode`). It comes after a `waitFor` on that same grid, so the grid is already captured and the read is safe.

The card's third done-when item, about the siblings, holds. At the head, `git grep -E 'gridOf|gridProps'` over the eight `*Members-8071` files finds only this file.

Check-runs on the head: 58 runs, 40 `success`, 18 `skipped`, 0 failed. `Test UI` passed, every planned shard passed, and `Check Changeset` passed. The UI leg ran in affected mode, so only slots 1 to 11 were planned. Slots 12 to 16 have no runs, and the workflow does that by design for an affected plan. `Type Check UI`, `Lint UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI` and the lint and type-check families all passed.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right. `@object-ui/plugin-form` lists `files` as `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` and `LICENSE` at the head, and a test file under `src/__tests__/` reaches none of them. Nothing that is published moves, so no version level is owed.

`Clause-②: no` on the PR body is right for the same reason, and so is `Metadata-protocol: none`. The diff declares, widens and narrows no capability.

### ③ Boundary flags

The dev raised no flag and listed no `open_questions` entry. The PR's own acceptance notes (the sentinel has no role or label; no ablation was run because no product behaviour changes) hold against the diff.

SQL push-down: nothing to check. The diff adds no id materialisation and no in-app join. It is a test mock and its lookup.

Note on case 6, not a finding: the `Notes` read passes if that grid's value is `[]` when it is first read, including before its fetch settles. Main already had that gap at the same point in the case, and this diff does not widen it.

No must-fix, no should-fix.
